title: 2027 Hyundai Palisade Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Hyundai Palisade is largely unchanged from the all-new version that arrived for 2026, but features some minor trim and color updates.
body_markdown:
The Hyundai Palisade is the brand’s midsize, three-row crossover SUV built to compete with models such as the Honda Pilot and the Toyota Grand Highlander, as well as the closely related Kia Telluride. Premium alternatives include the Acura MDX and the Volvo XC90. Hyundai introduced the Palisade for the 2020 model year, and a second-generation debuted for 2026. That redesign also added a decidedly rugged version, the Palisade XRT Pro, which joined a variety of other trims. A Palisade Hybrid model is also available and covered separately.

## What’s New for the 2027 Hyundai Palisade


An all-new Palisade arrived for the 2026 model year, so updates for 2027 are minimal. Exterior paint colors include new Ecotronic Gray, with Quantum Silver replacing Typhoon Silver and Cast Iron Brown no longer available. Inside, the Calligraphy trim level's UV sterilizer has been dropped, and lower trims feature a leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, a downgrade from the real leather used last year. More significantly, the Limited now offers eight-passenger seating and the SEL Convenience trim is gone.


## Design


While some Hyundai models go a little heavy on the body accent lines, the Palisade is more conservative. Up front are stacked LED headlights and daytime running lights, with a broad grille and a finish that varies by trim level. The XRT Pro stands out with black accents, red tow hooks, and a unique set of 18-inch alloy wheels wrapped in all-terrain tires. Lower trims also roll on 18s, but the Limited gets 20s, and the Calligraphy features 21-inch wheels. Most configurations use black cladding on the wheel wells and rocker panels, while higher trims add silver accents and the Calligraphy ditches the black for body-colored trim. Roof rails are standard on all versions except the base SE.


## Powertrain


Hyundai equips the 2027 Palisade with a 3.5-liter V6 producing 287 horsepower and 260 pound-feet of torque. An eight-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters and selectable drive modes is standard, as is front-wheel drive (FWD). All-wheel drive (AWD) is optional, except on the Palisade XRT Pro, which gets it as standard along with a limited-slip center differential and steering tuned for off-road driving. According to the EPA, FWD Palisades should return 19 mpg city, 26 mpg highway, and 22 mpg combined. With AWD, those figures drop to 18 mpg, 24 mpg, and 20 mpg. The XRT Pro drops that further to 16 mpg, 22 mpg, and 19 mpg. When properly equipped, the 2027 Hyundai Palisade can tow up to 5,000 pounds.


## Interior


In SE trim, the 2027 Palisade offers cloth-upholstered seating for eight: two front buckets, a three-passenger second-row bench, and a three-passenger third-row bench. Cargo space spans 19.1 cubic feet behind the third row to 86.7 cubic feet behind the front row. Second-row captain's chairs on higher trim levels cut standard seating to seven (the bench is optional on SEL, SEL Premium, and Limited) and available creature comforts include heated and ventilated front-row and second-row seats, heated third-row seats, a power driver's seat with adjustable lumbar support, leatherette or premium Nappa leather upholstery, and a heated steering wheel. The Calligraphy has massaging seats with Relaxation Mode, which automatically adjusts the seat to distribute body weight.


## Technology


All Palisades feature a single screen that spans much of the dash and includes a 12.3-inch infotainment display and, depending on the trim level, a 4.2-inch or 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster. Navigation is standard, as are natural voice recognition, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, Bluelink connected services, and six USB ports across the three rows. Hyundai also equips every Palisade with Wi-Fi hotspot capability and triple-zone automatic climate control. Quiet Mode lets front passengers listen to the sound system while dialing down the volume for rear occupants. Of course, everyone may prefer the sound from the available 14-speaker Bose audio upgrade. All trims include a wireless charger except the SE. From there, Hyundai sweetens the pot with Calligraphy-exclusive amenities such as a 12-inch head-up display and an integrated dashcam.

## Safety


With one notable exception, the Palisade's multiple safety features are standard across all trim levels. Every variant comes with blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, rear-collision warning, forward-collision warning with cyclist and pedestrian detection, a driver-attention monitor, and safe-exit assist. Hyundai also includes traffic-sign recognition, adaptive cruise control, and high-beam assist. A surround-view camera is standard starting with the SEL Premium. From there, equipment varies based on a trim's available suite of driver-assistance features. Lower trims get Highway Driving Assist I, which has semi-autonomous capability that manages speed, lane positioning, and distance from other vehicles. Highway Driving Assist II is limited to Calligraphy trims and adds lane-changing functionality plus visual cues in a head-up display. In National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) testing, the 2027 Hyundai Palisade earned a five-star overall rating, though it did not meet NHTSA's pedestrian protection performance criteria. The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety tests were free of caveats, and the Palisade was named a Top Safety Pick+ with Good ratings across the board.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Hyundai Palisade is on sale now and, at the time of writing, the 2027 Palisade SE FWD started at $39,735, rising to $42,240 for the SEL, $45,600 for the SEL Premium, $50,070 for the Limited, and $54,860 for the Calligraphy. AWD adds another $2,000 and there is an additional $1,650 destination charge for all versions. No option packages are available, but several accessories are, and premium paint colors add $500–1,000.
